description: 한국가스공사_LNG 수입국의 연도별 LNG 단기거래 비중 변화 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국가스공사. 글로벌 천연가스 및 LNG 거래 시장에서 20년 이상의 장기계약을 통해 거래되는 LNG 물량과 달리 LNG 카고 단위 또는 단기간 동안의 계약을 통해 거래되는 LNG 물량을 수입국. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
